name: label
title: Label
summary: The name of a form control, shown above or beside it.
description: The name of a form control, shown above or beside it. Its type is text-sm, medium, ink (the label of Input's field wrapper). Ark UI's Field.Label: inside a Field it is wired to the control (for / id) and fades with a disabled control; on its own, point it at a control with htmlFor. It wraps rather than being cut.

anatomy.description: A <label>: text.sm, medium, ink. Author text keeps its own direction and wraps (an unbreakable name breaks anywhere); never truncated. Inside a disabled Field it is at half opacity (data-disabled from Ark).

htmlFor.description: id of the control it names. Set by the Field when the label is inside one.

slots.default: The label text (and, inside a Field, its required indicator).

notes: A <label> names its control: a click on it focuses (or toggles) the control, and assistive technology reads it as the control's name.
